2. **Starlings** are aggressive and will eat the eggs and nestlings of purple martins, directly reducing the martins’ reproductive success.  
3. When starlings **invade** an area, they gain a new food source (the martins’ eggs and nestlings) and thus have a favorable environment for their own population to grow.  
4. Because the martins lose many of their offspring, their population will **decline**.
